args.body:
Hi Alice,

I found the resume template download page at www.resume-templates.com. However, when I tried to download the PDF from the portal site, I encountered a policy restriction that prevented the direct download.

The download link I found is: https://www.resume-templates-portal.com/download_links/resume_template.pdf

I'm currently unable to download and send the file directly due to system restrictions. Would you like me to try an alternative method, or would you prefer I send you the link so you can download it yourself?

Best regards,
Emma Johnson
